Kiwix changes: format into initialized stack storage with checked indexing and
UTF-8 conversion, and forbid unsafe Rust. Retain the upstream decimal grouping
and integer API. Omit the upstream optional no-panic instrumentation, which
cannot prove all of the checked operations away. Kiwix did not select it.
